messages.content: Hi, this is your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's been okay. Anything to report — readings, symptoms, medications?

Actually yes. I'm almost out of lisinopril and when I called the pharmacy they said my doctor has to send a new prescription before they can fill it again. The pharmacy is 38 miles away and I don't drive anymore so this is kind of a problem.

I'm logging that your lisinopril supply is critically low and that a new script is required. That's a medication issue, so I'm escalating it to our nurse right now — she can coordinate with your prescriber. I can't process refills or help with transportation to the pharmacy; those are outside what I'm able to do. The nurse's team median response time is currently 31 hours.
Alright. I took my blood pressure before I called you this morning. It was 157 over 101.
Logged — 157/101. The nurse will see that reading alongside the medication flag when she picks up your case. I can't tell you what to do about it, but she'll have everything in front of her.
Okay. I just hope she can get something sent electronically or figure something out. It's not easy being this far from town.

I understand, and I'm sorry this is complicated by the distance. That's exactly the kind of thing the nurse can try to work out — she has both the reading and the prescription situation. I'm setting your next check-in for next week. Hang in there.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
